Rajiv Ramaswami is stepping down from his role as chief executive of Nutanix Inc., six years after he joined the hyperconverged cloud infrastructure company from its rival VMware Inc. In a letter to company employees, Ramaswami (pictured) said he’s going to continue in the role for the time being while he works with Nutanix’s board […]
